items.q: How does junk removal pricing work?
items.a: By volume. The truck holds about {maxYards} cubic yards, and you pay for how much of it your stuff fills — from $175 for a quarter load to $655 for the whole truck. Just a few small items? That's our $125 minimum pickup. Heavy materials, Freon items and difficult access can add to it. We confirm the final number before we load anything.

items.q: What size load do I need?
items.a: Rough guide: a couple of small items is our $125 minimum pickup. A few big pieces is a 1/4 load. A one-car garage is often a 1/2. A basement or a remodel's worth of debris is usually 3/4. Whole-house cleanouts and demolition jobs tend to fill the truck. Upload photos when you book and we'll tell you if you're off.
A full truck. Our box is 16 feet long, 7 feet wide and 4 feet tall — about 17 cubic yards, or seven to eight heaped pickup-truck beds.
Yes. We're licensed and fully insured with a $3 million policy.
Yes. Couches, sectionals, mattresses, dressers, tables, desks, office furniture — from wherever it is in the building.
Yes — refrigerators, freezers, washers, dryers, stoves, dishwashers, water heaters. Anything with Freon (fridges, freezers, AC units) is $25 per item.

Yes. Drywall, lumber, cabinets, flooring, fixtures and general remodel waste. Concrete, brick, dirt and shingles too — heavy materials add about $75 per quarter load, and location or equipment needs can add more.

Yes — full interior guts, selective deconstruction, interior demolition, kitchens, bathrooms, sheds, decks, hot tubs and more. If the job needs a permit, we handle it. The debris leaves with us in the same job.

items.q: Do I need to be home?
items.a: No. Make sure we can get to everything and tell us where it is in the access notes when you book. We'll call to confirm the price before we load.

items.q: Do you take things out of the house, or just from the curb?
items.a: From wherever it is. Basements, attics, upper floors, backyards. Let us know about stairs and long carries when you book so we bring the right crew.
Tires, batteries, liquid paint, and hazardous materials — chemicals, solvents, fuel, asbestos, medical waste. If you're not sure about something, ask before you book.
Yes, when the schedule allows. Online booking shows any open window at least 2 hours out — if there's one today, you'll see it. Or call {phone} and we'll tell you the soonest we can get there.
Pick what you need gone and roughly how much, add your address and a few photos, choose an open arrival window, and confirm. You'll get a confirmation with links to reschedule or cancel.

items.q: What if I have more junk than I booked for?
items.a: No problem. We'll show you where it lands in the truck and give you the updated price before we load. You can add to the load or keep things back — your call.
Yes, free. Send a quote request with photos and we'll get back to you with a price. For junk removal, the load prices on this site are your estimate, confirmed before we load.
St. Louis City, St. Louis County and St. Charles County. See the service area page for the towns we cover — if you're just outside, call and ask.
To a landfill facility that sorts and separates materials, so what can be recycled is pulled out instead of buried.

items.q: What if I need to cancel or reschedule?
items.a: Use the link in your confirmation, or call {phone}. We ask for 24 hours' notice when you can — but we understand plans change.
